instruction: Refactor the currency conversion across src/currency.py and src/invoice.py. In src/currency.py, replace the legacy convert function with convert_currency(amount_cents: int, exchange_rate: float) -> int. The function must multiply amount_cents by exchange_rate and round to the nearest integer cent using standard rounding (use round()). Update src/invoice.py to import convert_currency instead of convert, and ensure calculate_total_cents calls convert_currency with the updated name and signature. Both files must typecheck and maintain their module-level exports. Do not modify src/config.py or any files outside src/currency.py and src/invoice.py.
